about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Nativity of the Lord — Mass at Dawn” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: May the birth-giving newness of this Sacrament ever restore us, O Lord, since His singular Nativity hath cast away the old corruption of human nature. Through the same our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son. Who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.

seg.nr: Then commemoration is made of Saint Anastasia, Martyr.

seg.tr: Thou hast satisfied Thy household, O Lord, with sacred gifts; ever refresh us, we beseech Thee, through the intercession of her whose solemn feast we celebrate. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son. Who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
